refnamediv.refpurpose: Design an FIR filter with an arbitrary frequency response.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: b = fir2(n, f, m) b = fir2(n, f, m, grid_n) b = fir2(n, f, m, grid_n, ramp_n) b = fir2(n, f, m, grid_n, ramp_n, window)

listitem.para: Vector of normalized frequency points (values between 0 and 1, where 1 corresponds to the Nyquist frequency).
Vector of magnitude values corresponding to the frequency points in `f`. Must be the same length as `f`.
(optional) Number of grid points for interpolation. Default is 512 or the next power of 2 greater than `n+1`.
(optional) Width of the ramp applied to discontinuities in the frequency response. Default is `grid_n / 25`.
(optional) Window function to shape the filter. If not specified, a Hamming window of length `n+1` is used.
Vector containing the FIR filter coefficients.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `fir2` function designs an FIR filter of order `n` with an arbitrary frequency response specified by the vectors `f` and `m`. The filter is designed using the frequency sampling method, where the desired frequency response is interpolated onto a grid and transformed into the time domain. An optional window can be applied to shape the filter.
